editorial:
You follow four bored college friends who rob a diner to pay for a wild Florida spring break, then get pulled into the orbit of a strange rapper named Alien who has his own criminal plans. The movie feels like a neon fever dream, mixing party scenes, danger, and slow-motion moments that make everything look both fun and unsettling. It is not a normal spring break comedy; it is a crime drama with a strange, hypnotic vibe that keeps you watching even when things get uncomfortable.

The standout is James Franco as Alien, who is weird, funny, and scary at the same time, while the four leads sell the shift from carefree girls to people in over their heads. The pacing can feel slow and repetitive, and the style may annoy you if you want a clear plot. Still, if you like bold, stylish crime stories, it is worth a look. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Alien is killed during a shootout at a rival drug dealer's mansion. Two of the girls survive, take his money and car, and drive away while the other two had already gone home. The ending shows the survivors returning to normal life, but the movie leaves you wondering how much they changed and whether the dream was worth the cost.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish crime dramas with a strange, dreamy edge.
